definitions.explanation: An argument or outlook holding that a situation will turn out well. Like {悲観論|ひかんろん}, it names a stated position in a debate rather than a personality trait, and is often used with a hint that the position may be too easy.

examples.japanese: {楽観論|らっかんろん}が{目立|めだ}つ。
{市場|しじょう}では{楽観論|らっかんろん}が{広|ひろ}がっている。
examples.english: Optimism is spreading in the market.

examples.japanese: {根拠|こんきょ}のない{楽観論|らっかんろん}は、{対策|たいさく}を{遅|おく}らせるだけだ。

notes:
{楽観|らっかん} (optimism) + {論|ろん} (argument, theory). Note the small っ in らっかん.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {楽観論|らっかんろん}が{広|ひろ}がる: for optimism to spread
- {根拠|こんきょ}のない{楽観論|らっかんろん}: groundless optimism
- {楽観論|らっかんろん}を{唱|とな}える: to argue an optimistic case
- {楽観論|らっかんろん}と{悲観論|ひかんろん}: the optimistic and pessimistic cases

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {楽観的|らっかんてき}: optimistic — the adjective, describing a person or an outlook
- {悲観論|ひかんろん}: pessimistic view — the direct opposite
